adjudicated_by: prior architect (Fable) + adversarial Kimi (K5) review recorded on issue #4356 during PR #4355's review -- predates and is independent of this #4324 diff and its author
adjudication_rationale: This finding derives HIGH/BLOCKING on its own stated facts (I2 base HIGH, E5 no change -- no E6 claim is made, since 'no reachable exploit found' is not a proof of impossibility). It does NOT block #4324's merge: the code (AgentRegistry::map_session, agent_registry.cpp:1398) is byte-for-byte untouched by this diff (0 hits in `git diff dev..HEAD` across the whole range); #4324's own review independently traced register_agent's phase-2 pointer-identity check (agent_registry.cpp:159-188) and confirmed it already refuses the simple two-way concurrent-registration race before either call reaches map_session, narrowing the real exploitable window to a 3-way overlap; and this narrowed mechanism is an exact dedupe match to the pre-existing, independent, non-self architect+Kimi adjudication already on file at #4356. Per Gate 7 Test 2, #4324's accepted scope (a same-session late-DISCONNECTED fence keyed on stream_home_id) does not require fixing this general, pre-existing registry-identity gap -- doing so would be the disproportionate unrelated-hardening anti-pattern the governance skill's own #2581 case study warns against.
